invalid_corpus: The quality corpus is invalid ({reason}). Restore the versioned corpus manifest and retry.
generation_failed: The MLX quality case {case_id} failed. Verify the model pack, available memory and output directory, then retry.
comparison_failed: Quality-corpus comparison failed ({case_id}). Verify every CUDA/MLX media pair, FFmpeg/FFprobe and the report directory, then retry.
blind_review_instructions: Review candidate A and B without inspecting file metadata or the private key. Rate every configured dimension, then record concise observable notes before moving to the next item.
blind_review_failed: Blind-review kit creation failed. Verify the configuration, corpus and both complete media directories, then retry.
blind_review_completed: Created a backend-anonymized blind-review kit with {count} items: {output}
demo_build_failed: The cinematic CUDA/MLX presentation could not be built ({reason}). Verify both native source videos, the versioned demo manifest, FFmpeg/FFprobe and free disk space, then retry.
demo_build_completed: Built the two individual 4K presentation files and the 4K side-by-side comparison. Report: {report}
clap_failed: CLAP prompt/audio alignment failed ({reason}). Verify the manifest, audio files, pinned checkpoint and evaluation environment, then retry.
clap_completed: Measured CLAP prompt/audio alignment for {count} cases. Report: {report}
videoscore_failed: VideoScore2 evaluation failed ({reason}). Verify the manifest, pinned source/model revisions, evaluator environment, GPU memory and video files, then retry.
